notes: One Indian statutory charge table. Exchange transaction rates are the client total recovered under SEBI True to Label (transaction charge plus investor-protection contribution). Brokerage is not in this table. Lot sizes are not in this table; they come from the instrument master. per_contract_inr is zero because the cited circulars levy a rate on traded value or premium, not a flat rupee fee per contract. The column is here so a later circular can add that fee without a new shape. A date before the first exchange row uses that first uniform rate.
